ios.desc:
Remember more of what you read.

Turn the passages that matter into a personal library you can search, revisit, and share. Point your camera at a book page, select the text, and save it with your notes, tags, and page number.

Keep your books organized, return to favorite ideas with reminders and widgets, and recap a book’s core ideas from your own highlights with Apple Intelligence.

CAPTURE

• Capture text with your camera or from photos in your library
• Select sentences and paragraphs with smart text recognition
• Automatically select text you’ve highlighted or underlined in a book
• Save multiple highlights from a page at once
• Detect page numbers and scan ISBN barcodes to add books
• Import highlights from Kindle or CSV files
• Import your book library from Goodreads or other CSV files
• Drag and drop images to capture highlights on iPad

ORGANIZE

• Build your personal bookshelf with collections and reading status
• Group highlights into chapters and browse them in reading order
• Add notes, tags, page numbers, and favorites
• Add emphasis with bold, italics, underline, and strikethrough
• Find relevant tags faster with smart suggestions
• Search your highlights and filter by book, collection, or tag

REVISIT

• Recap a book’s core ideas from your highlights with Apple Intelligence
• Rediscover saved passages with recurring highlight reminders
• Keep highlights on your Home Screen with widgets
• Start highlighting with Siri Shortcuts
• Capture and browse your highlights offline

SHARE & EXPORT

• Share highlights as beautiful quote cards
• Publish a book’s highlights as a web page anyone can read
• Export one book or your whole library
• Choose PDF, Markdown, CSV, RTF, or plain text
• Include notes, tags, and page numbers in your exports

FREE TO START

Capture and organize unlimited books and highlights for free. Highlighted+ adds automatic selection of marked text, Apple Intelligence recaps, Kindle and CSV highlight import, whole-library export, custom reminders, and more.

Apple Intelligence features depend on device, language, and system availability.

Selected as Apple’s App of the Day 6 times. Trusted by 160,000+ readers.

ABOUT ME
